description:
The Ministry of Health requires all diagnoses to be mapped to ICD-10 codes. You need to add a missing code to the system dictionary.

Create a new Concept Reference Term in the OpenMRS Administration interface with the following details:

1. Log in to the OpenMRS Administration interface (accessible via https://localhost/openmrs/admin)
   - Username: superman
   - Password: Admin123

2. Navigate to 'Manage Concept Reference Terms' (under the Dictionary or Concept section)

3. Add a new Concept Reference Term:
   - Concept Source: ICD-10-WHO
   - Code: A00
   - Name: Cholera
   - Description: Acute diarrhoeal infection caused by ingestion of food or water contaminated with the bacterium Vibrio cholerae

4. Save the new term.
